settings.label: System code
settings.help: Your BBSLink system code. The same account as the BBSLINK door - set it on either and the wall finds it.

settings.label: Auth code
settings.help: Hashed with the session token; never sent in the clear.

settings.label: Scheme code
settings.help: The second BBSLink secret. Hashed the same way as the auth code.

settings.label: Server host
settings.help: Where the wall lives. Only change this if BBSLink moves.

settings.label: HTTP port
settings.help: The wall is read and written over HTTP.

settings.label: Request timeout (seconds)
settings.help: How long to wait for BBSLink before giving up.
